teach.text: Letters 5–8 of 28. Look at the dots: they are what tells many letters apart.

teach.name: jeem
teach.note: A hook shape with one dot inside.

teach.name: Haa
teach.sound: a breathy 'h' from the throat (no English equivalent)
teach.note: Same hook as ج but with no dot. Capital H in 'Haa' reminds you it is the throaty one.

teach.name: khaa
teach.note: Same hook as ح with one dot above.

teach.name: daal
teach.note: A small corner shape. It does not connect to the next letter.
